# sdwan_network_hierarchy_nodes (Data Source)

This data source resolves a list of Network Hierarchy site, group and region names without requiring the hierarchy to be managed by this provider, in a single paginated read. `nodes` returns the UUID and type of every requested node, whatever its type, for consumers that reference a node itself (for example a scope). `resolved_sites` and `container_sites` expand groups and regions to the sites nested underneath them, at any depth, for consumers that need sites (for example topology targeting, where the Manager GUI sends the member sites and never the group's own UUID). Set `expand_containers` to `false` to return only `nodes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sdwan_network_hierarchy_nodes" "example" {
  names = ["EMEA-Group"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `names` (List of String) Site, group, or region names to resolve. A name that does not exist in the Network Hierarchy fails the read.

### Optional

- `expand_containers` (Boolean) Whether to build the site view: expand each group, region or `Global` in `names` to the sites nested underneath it. Defaults to `true`. When `false`, `resolved_sites` and `container_sites` are both empty and only `nodes` is returned. Use `false` when only the nodes' own ids are needed, so that a name like `Global` does not write every site in the hierarchy to state.

### Read-Only

- `container_sites` (Map of List of String) For each name in `names` that is a group, region, or `Global` (anything that is not a site), the names of the sites nested underneath it, at any depth. Use this to expand a group per consumer: `resolved_sites` is one flat, deduplicated set and cannot say which group a site came from. Site names in `names` never appear as keys. A container with no sites underneath it is present with an empty list - it is not an error here, so the caller decides whether an empty selection is acceptable.
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `nodes` (Attributes Map) One entry per name in `names`, keyed by name, whatever the node's type. Always populated, regardless of `expand_containers`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `resolved_sites` (Attributes List) The resolved, deduplicated set of sites: the sites named in `names` plus every site nested under a named group or region, so the UUID of a group member is available even though the member was not itself requested. Never includes the groups or regions themselves; use `nodes` for their ids. Empty when `expand_containers` is `false`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolved_sites))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The node's Network Hierarchy UUID
- `type` (String) The type of node: `site`, `region`, `group` or `global`


<a id="nestedatt--resolved_sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resolved_sites`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The site's Network Hierarchy node UUID
- `name` (String) The site's name
- `site_id` (Number) The site's numeric site ID
